children: Oil prices are vaulting toward their highest levels of the year while Americans begin early voting in the midterms. Brent crude futures recently hit $116 a barrel-a hair below their Iran War peak-as traders bet on renewed fighting after the election.
Here are some snapshots of the energy shock's impact as voters begin casting ballots:
Americans have already spent $142 billion more on gasoline and diesel this year than they would have in a peaceful 2026, according to the Climate Solutions Lab at Brown University.
The average nationwide price of gasoline Friday was $4.29 a gallon, according to AAA, 40% higher than a year ago.
Michigan and Ohio-both battleground states-have faced the largest uptick in prices over the past week.
